profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary:
Goal number one is to design software and data management systems to enable companies I work for make better well informed management decisions.

Goal number two is increase productivity by utilizing technology to allow everyone to work more efficiently, and report back to managers more accurately

My final goal is to utilize feedback both good and bad to improve systems I have designed or have been a part of designing.

Specialties: System Design, process management, workflow software, computer programming, reporting, database management.

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
Analysis and transformation of company's legacy system to Windows based platform with a SQL Server back end
Work closely with end company personnel to establish new core business processes and procedures
Designed new databases and applications to manage company workflow, and improve manufacturing efficiency
Applications include Production Scheduling, Customer Relationship Management, Order Management, Shipping and Receiving systems, Purchasing, graphics design management workflow, and inventory management software
Designed document management software to improve shipping efficiency by 50% using  electronic documents
Designed and Implemented companywide barcode system for both finished good, outer carton labeling, and order management 
Created systems to manage company molding and manufacturing history data to increasing recall accuracy and efficiency by more than 90%
Assisted in establishing company costing by providing tools to manage finished good costing data through both basic costs, and bill of material roll up costing
Produced applications to improve traffic functions related to weather sensitive shipments by providing a most cost effective ship method based on delivery date, UPS Time In Transit Web Services, UPS Rate Shop Web Services and the National Weather Service five day forecasting
Designed database query tools enabling users to create custom reports with drag and drop control to allow run time aggregation of data including two dimensional and high resolution 3D charting capabilities
Designed and managed company help desk/project management tools as well as information technology asset management allowing management to maintain license and support contract information
Create and manage crystal reports

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Analyze current client systems/configurations, and document recommendations for new system designs
Perform data conversions from ACT/MS Access to SQL Server, imports of legacy data
Develop applications in C# to import/export data over web services
Develop SageCRM.com web applications, web sites and data management
Create front end interfaces for Sage Saleslogix
Create end user documentation for database structures, system designs, and administrative tasks
Advanced query writing and report building using Crystal Reports 8.5, and XI
Query design, scripting, alert development using tools such as VineyardSoft Knowledgesync
Make recommendations for phase II development
Data synchronization using products such as Inaport/Dynalink
Train end users via webcasts

positions.title: Computer Programmer/Network Analyst
positions.description:
Analyze company's requirements and convert them into system design specifications
Designed Contact Management and operations support database
Created Collocation management software
Ensured data integrity with strict constraints
Successfully designed, tested, and implemented network management, and circuit inventory application using standard software development process. (Visual Basic 6 Front/Back end GUI, with Oracle 9i Database). 
Integrated new software with existing Element Management/Operations Support software.
Application developed to be fully upgradeable to accept alarming information from current network alarm monitoring software.
Developed training manuals, documentation and procedures in a web-based application
Developed system test requirements documents, and methods of procedure
Documented procedures to support end user acceptance testing, and analyzed test results
Created deployment packages for new software as well as upgrades/patches
Carefully documented software issues in production environment, corrected the problem in code, and deployed new versions
*       Successfully maintained, troubleshot, and provisioned optical transport and WDM (Wavelength Division Multiplexing) equipment. (Nortel OC-192/TN-64X, Nortel OC-48/TN-16X, Ciena CoreDirector, Ciena CoreStream).
*       Engineered optical equipment, carrier facilities (OC-3, OC-12, OC-192, STM-1, STM-4, STM-16, STM-64) and integrated customer circuits.
*       Utilized Network Management Systems, Operations Support Systems (OSS), and various other platforms to diagnose, report, and track network activity.  
*       Oversaw the 24x7 operation of Service Operations in regards to restoring service for optimal customer satisfaction.  
Troubleshot daily network issues and provided SLA (Service Level Agreement) support data to customers utilizing circuit analysis information, performance monitoring data, and network trend compilation data.

positions.title: Computer Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Analyze company's Central Information Monitoring System (CIMS) for enhancements.
Document new requirements as given by end users, and management to be incorporated into new system.
Created new database using MS SQL Server. Visual Basic 6.0 Back-End GUI, and management tool.
Designed Database Schema, including tables, views, stored procedures, triggers, and security management.
Maintained, and documented disaster recovery plans.
Imported and exported critical data using DTS.
Maintained Production and Development database, and ensured data replication.
*      Published System Design Documents, end user and management tool manuals to an intra-net site within company network.
New company finance management/new contract program using Visual Basic/SQL Server.
Managed and designed new company website incorporating HTML, ASP, DHTML
